description.zh:
水印模板ID。
>可查看[AddLiveStreamWatermark](~~2848096~~)接口返回参数值获取TemplateId。
description.en:
The ID of the watermark template.

> The template ID is returned in the response of the [AddLiveStreamWatermark](~~2848096~~) operation.

descriptions.zh:
本接口支持删除直播指定TemplateId的⽔印模板。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为60次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation deletes a live streaming watermark template based on a specified template ID.

## QPS Limits

You can call this operation up to 60 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.
